title: 2003 AMC 10A Problem 12
statement: A point \((x, y)\) is randomly picked from inside the rectangle with vertices \((0, 0),\) \((4, 0),\) \((4, 1),\) and \((0, 1).\) What is the probability that \(x \lt y?\)

solutions.text:
The condition \(x \lt y\) holds in the triangle bounded by \(y = x,\) \(y = 1,\) and \(x = 0,\) which has vertices \((0, 0),\) \((0, 1),\) and \((1, 1).\)

This triangle has area \(\dfrac{1}{2},\) while the rectangle has area \(4.\)

The probability is \(\dfrac{\frac{1}{2}}{4} = \dfrac{1}{8}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: The favorable region lies above the line \(y = x\)
Within the rectangle, that region is a triangle with legs of length \(1\)
